checked_claims.claim: Readonly checks ensure callable signature safety through two-tier validation
checked_claims.reason: Check only accepts callable/attribute/field; invocation TypeError is not an explicit runtime validation layer and does not guarantee safety.

material_errors: Check only accepts callable/attribute/field; invocation TypeError is not an explicit runtime validation layer and does not guarantee safety.
tasks.notes: Direct central-claim source review; no repository code execution.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: _check_readonly_fields_item accepts callable entries directly, or names present on ModelAdmin/model, or model metadata fields (django/contrib/admin/checks.py:792-818). admin.display adds metadata and returns the same function (django/contrib/admin/decorators.py:58-77). No signature validation occurs here; a named decorated method passes attribute lookup, while a directly supplied function passes callable(). At rendering, lookup_field invokes it, so incompatible signatures may still raise a runtime TypeError (django/contrib/admin/utils.py:296-305).

checked_claims.claim: Article migration uses router then creates tablespace-backed model
checked_claims.reason: Article is managed=False, omitted in reference; normal migrations do not create this model even if router permits.

material_errors: Article is managed=False, omitted in reference; normal migrations do not create this model even if router permits.
tasks.notes: Direct central-claim source review; no repository code execution.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: Article specifies model tablespace tbl_tbsp and idx_tbsp on code and reviewers, but is managed=False (tests/model_options/models/tablespaces.py:33-44), so normal migrations do not create its table. For migratable models, CreateModel checks allow_migrate_model before schema_editor.create_model (django/db/migrations/operations/models.py:97-100); unmanaged models are excluded by Options.can_migrate (django/db/models/options.py:387-400). Index tablespace resolution uses explicit/field settings, DEFAULT_INDEX_TABLESPACE, then model tablespace (django/db/backends/base/schema.py:1521-1531). Backend SQL support and pre-existing tablespaces remain separate database concerns.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: The template quotes original.pk with admin_urlquote, reverses the history route into history_url, then renders add_preserved_filters directly inside href (django/contrib/admin/templates/admin/change_form_object_tools.html:4-5). Admin quoting translates problematic path characters (django/contrib/admin/utils.py:89-96). The url tag with as history_url stores the reversed URL without conditional_escape (django/template/defaulttags.py:489-495). add_preserved_filters adjusts the query string, and SimpleNode.render conditionally HTML-escapes its output once (django/template/library.py:319-327). There is no extra variable-render escaping stage for this tag output.
